targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM gold.mart_slot_status
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT depositor_name) AS value FROM gold.mart_slot_status
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_rub), 0) AS value FROM gold.mart_billing WHERE billing_month = DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())
SELECT period_label AS "Период", SUM(amount_rub) AS "Сумма (руб.)" FROM gold.mart_billing GROUP BY period_label ORDER BY period_label
SELECT depositor_name AS "Поклажедатель", SUM(amount_rub) AS "Сумма" FROM gold.mart_billing WHERE billing_month = DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) GROUP BY depositor_name ORDER BY "Сумма" DESC

SELECT store_name AS "Склад", zone_name AS "Зона", slot_name AS "Ячейка", depositor_name AS "Поклажедатель", product_name AS "Товар", lot AS "Партия", quantity AS "Кол-во", occupied_from AS "Занята с", days_since_in AS "Дней" FROM gold.mart_slot_status ORDER BY store_name, zone_name, slot_name

SELECT period_label AS "Период", depositor_name AS "Поклажедатель", depositor_inn AS "ИНН", unique_slots_used AS "Ячеек", ROUND(total_slot_days::numeric, 1) AS "Ячейко-дней", amount_rub AS "Сумма (руб.)" FROM gold.mart_billing ORDER BY billing_month DESC, amount_rub DESC

SELECT started_at AS "Запущен", finished_at AS "Завершён", CASE is_cold_start WHEN true THEN 'Холодный старт' ELSE 'Инкрементальный' END AS "Тип", status AS "Статус", rows_inserted::text AS "Записей", error_message AS "Ошибка" FROM raw_moysklad.sync_log ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 10
